data.body: WAVE 3 UNDERWAY - arms dispatched against a corrected concurrency picture. THE CEILING IS 20, NOT 40: the env var reads 40 and the harness refused the 21st dispatch, so the only trustworthy check is a refused dispatch, and the restore entry recording 40 from an echo was wrong. CE spends ~7 slots on its persona team and superpowers ~2, so 2 CE + 3 SP = 20 exactly and CE is hard-capped at 2 concurrent whatever else runs. All 20 repos materialized at their pinned SHAs (12-char abbrevs expanded via API, expansion checked to extend the abbrev, HEAD compared to the expansion, all depth-1 detached so no pull can advance a review target). MINI ARM COMPLETE 20/20, 148 findings, 57.56 dollars, mean 2.88. NEW FINDING the single-codebase Wave 1 could not see: mini's step budget binds on REPOSITORY size, not just plan size - java-gradle (38k plan, 293MB repo) died at 150 steps having spent 2.71 of 8 dollars, then submitted at 177 calls at 260; go-gitea needed 158. Raise MINI_STEPS, never MINI_COST; the dollar cap never binds. Two of 20 mini runs needed intervention to be readable and both were QUOTING artefacts that Wave 1's Python corpus concealed: extract.py's bare-array fallback was a non-greedy regex that truncated on a brace-then-bracket inside a description string (a complete 7-finding array read as NO OUTPUT; fixed with a JSON-decoder widest-span scan, verified over all 880 Wave 1 arm-cells with zero differences and all 20 frozen ballots still matching their pinned hashes), and one submission had unescaped quotes repaired mechanically with each edit driven by the decoder's error position and the result verified identical once quotes are stripped. DESIGN-LENS HAS FIRED FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE STUDY - it declined to activate on every Wave 1 run for lack of UI content, activated on both Wave 3 CE runs, and returned findings on js-gutenberg, which is also the first full-fidelity Wave 3 CE run (6 personas, all returned). The calibration control go-gitea is being re-run: it synthesized from 5 of 7 personas because coherence and design-lens dispatched cleanly and never returned, and MY resume message caused it by asserting the reviewers had all returned when the harness signal only means none is still running. Rule adopted: a resume must never assert what an agent's children produced.
